einzeiler: Liza Powel O'Brien joins Conan, Sona, and Matt to discuss 25 years of marriage.
kurzfassung: Liza Powel O'Brien is the guest on Summer Spouses, discussing her marriage to Conan O'Brien. She shares stories about Conan's chaotic kitchen habits, fast eating style, and their memorable first date. The conversation highlights their contrasting personalities and long-standing relationship.
stichpunkte: Liza Powel O'Brien appears as a guest on the Summer Spouses series.
The hosts discuss last names and the history behind the Powell surname.
Liza describes Conan's messy kitchen habits, noting he leaves every cupboard door open.
Conan explains his rapid, compulsive eating style rooted in childhood dynamics.
Liza recalls their first date, which included seeing a movie and going to a Mexican restaurant.
Conan mistakenly ordered a whiskey neat on their first date, a drink he never orders.
The couple shares the story of taking a cab downtown to meet friends while awkwardly navigating early dating dynamics.
